timecoded_text_to_speech.text: AI is a different sort of inflection point that we have not experienced yet in our lives or careers.
It is a risk and an opportunity. On one side 42% of CEOs believe that AI has the potential to destroy humanity in 5 to 10 years.
So there's that. And on the opposite side it could bring peace, solv hunger, save the planet and end cancer.
And Elon Musk's words, it's likely to be the best or worse thing that happened to humanity.
So you can either be curious, afraid, excited or intimidated, ready or unready.
And I choose to be ready.
